description: Keeps the k3s cluster's images current. Depends on the convention in k8s/README.md: every image is `repository:tag@digest` and resolves from a values file, never a chart template. Validated by running Renovate against this repo: the image manager extracts 9 of 9 pins. The chart-image-digests workflow fails CI if a pin drifts from its tag, so a reference that stops matching this config is loud rather than silent.

customManagers.description: Container images in the chart values files (ai + wiki). Keys are matched as *image:/*Image: because the charts name them per consumer (image, toolsImage, postgresImage) - a literal image: pattern silently drops the others. Patterns are globs, not /regex/: an unescaped / inside a slash-delimited pattern ends the regex early and matches nothing. There is deliberately no autoReplaceStringTemplate here: Renovate replaces the whole match, and the match starts at the key, so a template that emits `image:` renames toolsImage/postgresImage and breaks the helm render. Without a template Renovate substitutes the tag and digest inside the match and leaves the key and repository alone.

Helm charts vendored as GitHub release tarballs in nix/services/k3s.nix. packageName comes from the URL and the archive name becomes the depName, so commit messages name the chart rather than the repo. No annotation to remember: a fourth chart is covered the moment someone adds it extractVersion is required: these are monorepo release tags (loki-20.0.1, kube-prometheus-stack-91.7.0), and without stripping the chart name Renovate finds no candidate that parses as a version and files nothing - silently.

packageRules.description: llama.cpp publishes each CUDA build as its own tag (server-cuda12-b11151, 858 of them, newest b11889). Docker versioning cannot order those, so Renovate sees no upgrade at all and offers only a digest move; the regex versioning ranks them by build number. Never auto-merged: a bad build is a model that will not wake, and the per-model pins differ on purpose (b10603 on qwen3 for IQ4_XS support).

A digest-only bump means the content behind a tag moved - usually a CVE fix to a base image, which is worth knowing about, but it is an unreviewed content change under a version that looks unchanged, so it never merges by itself.
Patch bumps merge on green, matching the existing update-flake-lock workflow. Minor and major wait for a human.
A model's serving image is the one dependency where a wrong build costs a GPU and an outage that looks like a deploy.
The gateway holds the LiteLLM master key and fronts every route; its updates are reviewed.

autoReplaceGlobalMatch because each version appears twice in the URL - the release path and the asset filename - and Renovate substitutes only the first occurrence by default, leaving a URL that half-points at the new asset. Never auto-merged: these charts render the monitoring stack, and a chart patch can rewrite a dashboard or an alert rule. The sha256 is repaired by the chart-hash-fixup workflow, which Renovate cannot do itself.
